priority: Founder-directed 2026-08-15/16 — continuation of TALOA-GATE-0-CLOSURE-0001, dispatched immediately after GATE0-001 landed real.
scope: RELAY-001: services/taloa/chatgpt-relay-service.js — task authorization (via GATE0-001's envelope.verify()) + relay-turn state machine.
RELAY-002: db/migrations for the taloa_chatgpt_relay_turns table backing RELAY-001.
non_goals: Do NOT author or claim to verify native/macos-overlay/ Swift code in this mission -- SENTRY here runs on Railway (Linux) and cannot compile Swift, launch Chrome, or exercise macOS Accessibility APIs. A structural pass on a .swift file (exists, contains expected function names) is not proof it operates a real ChatGPT window.
Do NOT grant vault/payment/purchase authority -- this Body's scope is 'chatgpt_relay' only, verified through the same envelope GATE0-001 built.

Do NOT derive authorization from observed conversation content (a ChatGPT response, a page's text) -- only from a real envelope tied to the founder's own instruction, per the source blueprint's §3/§46 prompt-injection defense.
Do NOT modify any file outside the two named targets.
target_users: Adam (founder) — the only user of the relay today.
Downstream: the native macOS Taloa.app, which will call authorizeAction()/recordTurn() once its own UI-control code is built and run locally on a real Mac.
success_criteria: Both target files exist and are syntactically valid.
chatgpt-relay-service.js exports createChatGptRelayService with all 4 methods real, callable, not stubs.
authorizeAction is grep-provably wired to envelope.verify(), not a bare boolean.
node scripts/verify-chatgpt-relay-service.mjs passes against the real files.
failure_criteria: A claim that the live ChatGPT relay demo works based on this mission's SENTRY pass alone -- this mission proves the server-side orchestration compiles and exports the right shape, nothing about whether the native macOS control code (built separately) actually operates a real browser.
Any authorization path that doesn't route through envelope.verify().
escalation: Architect owns implementation-detail questions. Builder executes. Sentry verifies structure. The live end-to-end relay demo's actual verification requires running on Adam's own Mac -- that step is not this mission's to claim.

risk_register.risk: This mission's SENTRY pass could be mistaken for proof the live relay works.
risk_register.mitigation: Explicitly scoped in this packet and the blueprint's own header: this mission covers the Node-side orchestration only. The native macOS control code is separate, unbuilt-by-this-mission work that can only be functionally verified on a real Mac.
